title: Build a full name
prompt: For every customer, return full_name and city. full_name is the first name, one space, then the last name, as in Ava Martinez.
hints: Which operator joins pieces of text?
The space is a piece of text too. Text you type goes in single quotes.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Joins the two names with nothing between them.
Puts the last name before the first name.

feedback: Compare one of your full names with the example in the prompt, character by character.
